_comment: Detail checklist of the class (asset.check section coverage): the definition of done of an asset
of this class. Generated from the vanilla models of the class (13; every model of the class): an item every one of them
has (95 % for classes of 20 and more) is required ('missing' blocks asset.check --strict), an item at
least a quarter of them have is optional. 'vanilla' = how many vanilla models of the class have it.
satk.style.coverage. More detail in the same SA style is welcome; nothing here is a triangle count.

items.what: headlamps on the headlight key colours of vehiclelights128
items.fix: give the headlamp lenses the key colour 255,175,0 (left) / 0,255,200 (right) on vehiclelights128, set into a recess

items.what: tail lamps on the taillight key colours
items.fix: give the tail lamp lenses the key colour 185,255,0 (left) / 255,60,0 (right) on vehiclelights128

items.what: windows: glass with alpha below 255 (windscreen part, doors or body)
items.fix: glass panes on the generic glass region of vehiclegeneric256 with alpha 128 (windscreen_ok, door and body windows)
build the wheel (tyre + rim) as the atomic 'wheel' under a wheel dummy; the game copies it to the others

items.what: door mirrors standing out of the body side
items.fix: add mirrors on short stalks that touch the doors, head 18-32 cm, glass on vehiclelights128

items.what: door handles as small pieces on the doors
items.fix: add handles (6-14 triangles, about 3 x 18 x 8 cm) sitting on the door skins
cut the doors from the shell as door_lf_ok / door_rf_ok (and rear doors) under their dummies
cut the bonnet from the shell as bonnet_ok
cut the boot lid or tailgate as boot_ok
build wrap-around bumpers as bump_front_ok / bump_rear_ok, joined to the body along a line
add 4-8 triangle plate cards on carplate / carpback, set on the bumpers

items.what: an interior (seats, dashboard) inside the cabin
items.fix: build shaped seats, a dashboard with a gauge hood and door cards on a dark interior atlas
add a steering wheel card or ring on vehiclesteering128 at the driver's side
add a gauge card on vehicledash32 in the dashboard

items.what: an engine block and inner walls under the bonnet
items.fix: put an engine block (and an air cleaner) under the bonnet so an open bonnet is not empty

items.what: an exhaust pipe at the exhaust dummy
items.fix: build the exhaust pipe (16-32 triangles) ending at the exhaust dummy
close every arch with a short return face and a liner plate
